question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones states its initiatives include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones states the Partnership is subject to risk from generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations and demographics, and is making significant investments in financial advisors and other human capital, technology, digital initiatives, and strategic relationships to support long-term growth.
items.quote: The Partnership's continued ability to compete and adapt its business model may be adversely impacted by the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, including changing client expectations for expanded product offerings and technology needs, and changing client demographics, preferences and values.

items.text: Edward Jones states the Partnership seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the generational wealth transfer, through initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact, and is making significant investments to attract and retain qualified talent.
items.quote: The Partnership seeks to address its strategic risks, most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, changing client demographics, preferences and values, technology, artificial intelligence, and regulatory changes, through its initiatives to deliver enhanced value and impact for millions of current and potential clients, colleagues and communities.

items.text: Edward Jones states it has taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, with the intention of integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities into Edward Jones to support its value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken , with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones as a way to support their value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.

items.text: Edward Jones principal Katherine Roy stated the firm's advisors work with local business owners every day and the firm wants to create opportunities for advisors to expand access to retirement plans, supported by a new AI-powered retirement plan management tool developed with Aboon and Retirement Plan Advisory Group.
items.quote: Given our strong footprint in our communities, our advisors are working with local business owners every single day... We want to be able to create those opportunities for advisors and really pull that through the lifecycle.

cells.reason: The passages contain multiple strategic initiatives and leadership statements directly related to capturing generational wealth transfer (Next Generation platform, High Net Worth, Workplace, Quicken stake, retirement tool) and leadership statements acknowledging the wealth transfer as a strategic priority.
